answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 5306 Country: India Title: Brother i am going to marry in next six month and i am afraid of one thing.I am having very Bad odor in my mouth and I am using miswak regularly for namaaz but the bad odor is not getting reduced.Will this affect my marriage life. Please give me suggestion on this or some dua and what should i do.Sorry for asking medical related question. Question: Assalaamualeikum Brothers, Brother i am going to marry in next six month and i am afraid of one thing.I am having very Bad odor in my mouth and I am using miswak regularly for namaaz but the bad odor is not getting reduced.Will this affect my marriage life. Please give me suggestion on this or some dua and what should i do.Sorry for asking medical related question. Answer ID: 5306 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 332/332=M/1429) Continue using miswak , recite the Holy Quran as much as you can and chew aniseed occasionally. Better, consult a physician and get treatment. However, bad odour may not affect the validity of your nikah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
